missing: Overnight runtimes measured by a major independent lab, using a real CPAP with the heated humidifier and tube on. The same tests should check two things: whether the station's eco mode shuts off the outlet at low CPAP load, and whether its backup switchover keeps the machine running when power cuts out.
why: No major reviewer or authority source appears in these results. Several small sites give specific nights-per-charge figures, but most are worked out from capacity specs. Only one claims to have actually run a CPAP overnight, and even that page carries a 'third-party test data' label. The result is enough niche coverage to answer the question, but not from sources strong enough to call it settled.
